question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.opa: The atomic radius of fluorine and chlorine are identical.
options.opb: The atomic radius of chlorine is less than that of fluorine.
options.opc: Bromine has the highest atomic radius of halogens.
options.opd: Fluoride has the lowest atomic radius of halogens.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Atomic radius" -> "Decreases across a period from left to right on the periodic table" -> "Fluorine is to the right of chlorine" -> "Fluorine has a smaller atomic radius than chlorine" -> 95% CHAIN: "Atomic radius" -> "Increases down a group on the periodic table" -> "Bromine is below fluorine and chlorine" -> "Bromine has the highest atomic radius among the halogens" -> 95%
